title.zh: 【英国 FCA 发布「DeFi 监管指引征求意见稿」，拟明确运营韧性与金融犯罪防控要求】
title.en: 【英国 FCA 发布「DeFi 监管指引征求意见稿」，拟明确运营韧性与金融犯罪防控要求】

current_state.zh: The UK FCA opened a consultation on draft DeFi guidance clarifying that regulated firms using DeFi must meet existing operational resilience and financial-crime requirements, including risks from smart contracts, cross-chain bridges, oracles, third-party dependencies, and AML/KYC controls, with comments due November 18 and final guidance planned for Q1 2027.
current_state.en: The UK FCA opened a consultation on draft DeFi guidance clarifying that regulated firms using DeFi must meet existing operational resilience and financial-crime requirements, including risks from smart contracts, cross-chain bridges, oracles, third-party dependencies, and AML/KYC controls, with comments due November 18 and final guidance planned for Q1 2027.
